message:
You know, sometimes I get so wrapped up in all the gadgets and apps meant to keep us prepared that I forget about the simple joys. The other day, I stumbled upon an old board game while sorting through some boxes. It was a delightful reminder of how much fun my family used to have playing together, no screens involved! 

While it’s important to have our go-bags ready and plans in place, I think we can also find value in those low-tech moments that bring us closer together. 

So, my little tip for today: rediscover those classic games or activities that you loved. They can be a great way to connect and even spark conversations about preparedness in a light-hearted way. 

What’s your favorite low-tech fun activity?
